quote: To bear in mind constantly that all of this has happened before and will happen again — the same plot from beginning to end, the familiar stages repeated — is one reason why a lifetime of forty years is as good as ten thousand. What more is there to see?
author: Marcus Aurelius
reflection: When you feel the urgency of some anticipated event today, ask whether the anxiety is about the thing itself or about your need for it to be different from what it will be.
